question: - **base device** and **base shim** become their own machine entries, owned by Cairn, which every device and shim subclasses?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer: I said base was a machine only because it was made up of multiple files. But it doesn't need to be a machine. Base device is the base class for all devices that are internal. Base shim is the base shim class for all of the shims which will be customized for each device they interface with, internal or external. I believe there is also a base domain. But I would say the base shim, base device, base domain, all inherit from base. And bring with them the logging, diagnostics, and core patterns.
